Also FACTIONS.allies (3, e.g. {"Imperial Agents":"Assigned Agents"}) and ARMIES.units.ref (4: check.js checks the quote, nobody signs it). FACTIONS.*.tableAt and the *.over columns are empty today.
fix: verify/helpers.js:68 `if(ab.ph || ab.turn || ab.at) add(a.id, 'ability-timing', w + ' · ' + ab.name, { ph:ab.ph, turn:ab.turn, turns:ab.turns, at:ab.at }, src);`. at is undefined on every other ability, so no other key changes. verify/helpers.js:110: build the rule list from verify/columns.json the way STRAT_KEYS is built: every column of FACTIONS.armyRules, FACTIONS.detachments.rule and FACTIONS.detachments.moreRules whose source is hand, ai-summary or ai-reading, minus coreTwin, which has its own item. That adds at and tableAt. After the alias loop at :128, add `for(const f of Object.values(D.factions)) if(f.allies) add(f.name, 'faction-allies', f.name, { allies:f.allies }, { rules:Object.values(f.allies).map(n => n + ': ' + (D.rules[n] || '')) });` and in the unit loop `if(u.ref) add(a.id, 'unit-ref', w, { ref:u.ref }, cited(a.id, u, { from:u.ref.rule || u.ref.strat }));`. That gives about 24 at, 3 allies and 4 ref items to sign. If you would rather not sign allies and ref, add "the allies a faction may take, reference sheets" to the not-signed sentence of the Hand legend (app.html:1871) instead.
